site_schema.summary: The structured data presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and promotes development services that are not part of the approved offer. It also contains unsupported or inaccurate service claims, founder details, timelines, and guarantees that need correction.

problems.title: Applied AI Engineering positioning
problems.issue: The schema describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner rather than using the approved company description.
problems.fix: Replace the positioning and description with the approved company description and remove the prohibited Applied AI Engineering framing.
problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
problems.source_value: GoGloby is a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner

problems.title: AI-native production terminology
problems.issue: The schema uses the prohibited phrase “turn engineering into AI-native production” and leads with AI spend and speed claims.
problems.fix: Remove the prohibited terminology and AI-spend-led claim.
problems.subject: GoGloby positioning

locations.quote: GoGloby turns engineering into AI-native production.
every AI dollar visible, every feature shipped faster.

problems.title: Generative AI development offer
problems.issue: The catalog promotes generative AI development and delivery services, which are not among GoGloby’s approved services.
problems.fix: Remove the development-services offer and its delivery claims from the catalog.

problems.source_value: US Data & AI Engineers Recruiting; Nearshore Data & AI Engineers Staffing

problems.title: Staffing delivery promises
problems.issue: The staffing schema promises profiles in 72 hours and a validated feature in 3 to 5 business days, neither of which is supported by the sources.

locations.quote: Vetted profiles delivered in 72 hours. First validated feature in 3 to 5 business days.

problems.title: Recruiting speed claims
problems.issue: The schema claims a five-day shortlist and 50 percent faster hiring than US job boards, which are not supported by the sources.
problems.fix: Remove the unverified shortlist and comparative hiring-speed claims.
problems.subject: Recruiting timeline

locations.quote: Shortlist delivered in 5 days. 50 percent faster time-to-hire than US job boards.

problems.issue: The “120-day telemetry-backed” staffing guarantee does not match the stated performance-based replacement terms, while recruiting has a 120-day free replacement guarantee.
